failed_checks_explained.first_pass/residual: PSL best lepton chi: cross-check gets 162.1. Diagnosis (original code, data_targets.pull_delta and e4_fits.lepton_pulls): delta is wrapped into [bf-180, bf+180) = [-3, 357) deg before the one-sided pull, so delta = 0 = 360 deg (inside NuFIT's 3sigma range 96..422) gets pull -6.56 instead of +2.24. Reproducing that wrap gives 200.05. Verdict unchanged (excluded either way).

texture.note_first_pass_disagreement: first pass: lepton|min|G|P|P chi2 76.31 vs original 72.49 (same verdict; the original's minimum is lower, i.e. the first-pass optimiser stopped higher). The 4 classes at 72.49 agree otherwise.
texture.convention_fix: second pass refitted all 64 'gen' lepton classes with a consistent (holomorphic) PMNS convention; the first pass mixed conventions (U_e from M_e M_e^dagger, U_nu conjugated)

real_coupling_variant.note: NOT part of the original survey: LNR 'min' classes with real alpha, beta (LNR's own convention). Classes phi5=Z3/phi1=P, phi5=P/phi1=Z3, phi5=P/phi1=P (each with phi10=G) have dof = 1 and p > 0.01, i.e. they SURVIVE the preregistered rule. With complex alpha, beta (the original's unstated choice) they have dof = 0.

issues.description: Texture-survey headline '0 predictive survivors / no alignment class both fits and predicts' depends on an unstated choice: in the 'min' (LNR leading-order) variant alpha and beta are COMPLEX in the original code (e4_fits.coupl / lepton_obs), while LNR use real alpha = beta = -1. With real alpha, beta (CP-conserving couplings, CP violation only from vev phases) the classes phi10=G with (phi5,phi1) = (Z3,P), (P,Z3), (P,P) have N_eff = 6, dof = 1 and fit NuFIT 6.0 with chi2 = 0.14 / 0.02 / 0.14 (p = 0.71 / 0.89 / 0.71): they SURVIVE the preregistered rule. Found in the first pass (cc_texture --minreal) and confirmed by independent code (cc2_minreal_verify.py).
issues.suggested_fix: State that alpha, beta are complex in 'min'; report the real-coupling variant (3 survivors, dof = 1; their 'prediction' is a discrete set of delta values) and soften 'none fits and predicts' to 'none with complex couplings'.

issues.description: delta pull wraps delta into [bf-180, bf+180) = [-3, 357) deg (data_targets.pull_delta, e4_fits.lepton_pulls), inconsistent with NuFIT's asymmetric 3sigma range 96..422 deg: delta = 0 = 360 gets pull -6.56 instead of +2.24. Best PSL full-residual lepton pattern is chi2 = 162.1, not 200; non-surviving Z2-partial classes are inflated (e.g. 400.75 vs 362.80). No pass/fail verdict changes (all texture survivors/accommodations and the three Z2-partial survivors have delta inside 96..357).
issues.suggested_fix: Pick the representative delta + 360k closest in pull (or wrap into [96, 456)); correct 200 -> 162 in report and results.json.

issues.description: Report/summary say 23 fit-'excluded' classes were relabelled structural after the rank scan, with chi2 'about 5e3 to 1e4' and m_e/m_mu or m_d/m_s 1e-7..1e-4 rounding noise. results.json itself has 26 relabelled (22 lepton + 4 quark), chi2 from 1.5e3 to 3.1e6; the rounding-noise explanation fits the 19 Z7 classes, the other 7 are dead through r = 1 degeneracy or a permutation CKM.
issues.suggested_fix: Change 23 -> 26 and the chi2 range; split the causes.

issues.description: 'Three distinct masses need 1+1'+1'' vevs together' is overstated: any two of the three singlet vevs (1+1', 1+1'', 1'+1'') already give three distinct masses generically (checked numerically).
issues.suggested_fix: Say 'at least two of 1, 1', 1'' (F21 broken to Z7) or triplet vevs'.

issues.description: '10 distinct mixing patterns' (F21) and '97' (PSL) count (sector kind, G_l type, G_nu type, |U|^2) tags, double counting the same matrix for quark and Dirac-lepton use; the number of distinct |U|^2 structures up to row/column permutations is 3 (F21) and 26 (PSL).
issues.suggested_fix: Define the count or quote distinct |U|^2 structures.

issues.description: The haze sign is described as 'an input chosen to reproduce LNR's 32.4 deg'; it is fixed by LNR's printed U_-1 (only that sign reproduces all nine entries of their displayed U_MNSP to O(lambda)), so it is not a free choice.
issues.suggested_fix: Say the sign is LNR's (their printed U_-1).

issues.description: 'Leptonic patterns that fit come from PSL(2,7)'s Z2 elements (shared with S4)': true for TM1 (<Z3,t> = S4) and TM2 (<Z3,t> = A4); the Z7 class generates the whole PSL(2,7) (<Z7,t> = 168), so '(shared with S4)' does not apply to it. The report's table text is correct.
